purpose: Lab-only quote-only review-order addendum, defined after the extraction/policy freeze and before any holdout labels exist.
basis: Development quote-mapping workflow and explicit experiment requirement; no holdout predictions or labels were inspected to define this order.
reviewOrder: Ascending ordinal priority: missing, altered or unmappable quotes first; ambiguous occurrences second; mapped quotes last. The first three statuses share one priority.
tieBreak: Result-path segments ascending, numeric segments numerically and string segments lexically; numeric segments sort before strings if types differ. Family name breaks identical paths only in pooled summaries.
reviewMetrics: Use the same deterministic queue for joint-evidence error and unsupported-value precision/recall at 1, 3 and 5 reviews per Extraction. Exclude unresolved labels from scored metrics.
coverageOrder: Descending ordinal priority retains mapped quotes first, ambiguous quotes second, and missing/altered/unmappable quotes last; keep the same ascending path tie-break.
calibration: Quote-only Brier scores and reliability remain unavailable; ordinal priorities are not probabilities.
unchanged: No extraction, quote matching, model, threshold, candidate-selection, or E routing changes.
